package.description: This extension derives a number of respiratory parameters based on flow and volume, including VE, VT, frequency, PIF, PEF, FVC, FEV1. This extension also generates a flow-volume plot and spirometry reports.

en-US.description: This extension derives a number of respiratory parameters based on flow and volume, including VE, VT, frequency, PIF, PEF, FVC, FEV1. This extension also generates a flow-volume plot and spirometry reports.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Spirometry

zh-CN.description: 该扩展基于流量和容积计算多项呼吸参数，包括每分钟通气量 (VE)、潮气量 (VT)、呼吸频率、吸气峰流速 (PIF)、呼气峰流速 (PEF)、用力肺活量 (FVC)、第一秒用力呼气容积 (FEV1)。该扩展还能生成流量-容积曲线图及肺功能检测报告。

package.name: ADInstruments Spirometry
